Deliberate boundaries

Useful questions.
Honest unknowns.

  • Useful-task efficiency, not just token prices.Quality and failed attempts belong in the denominator.
  • Evidence-conditional company research.Anthropic is an anchor, not a proxy for the whole sector.
  • Operational impacts, with place and boundaries.No company-energy totals inferred from revenue.
  • Contestable scenarios, not investment forecasts.Future results must retain assumptions and provenance.

What this demo does—and does not—authorize

The author requested this narrow, non-analytical shell and separately approved the specification and plan on November 28, 2026. Claim reconciliation, calibrated models, and analytical publication still require their evidence and review gates.

No verified financial amounts, provider rankings, simulated results, or reported impact estimates are shown.
